text:
Amy (Sales): Greenline Labs asks if we can run a fully air-gapped POC w/ no USB allowed (courier-only), signed bundles, SBOM, offline activation, and a strict upgrade freeze for 18 months. They also want pricing options (per-core vs per-node) and a short preflight checklist for their security team. Can we confirm feasibility and call out any blockers?
Ben (SE): Feasible but constraints: no USB is fine — we support jumpbox transfer via an approved intermediary VM or courier HDD that we treat like jumpbox. We do chunked, signed bundles + per-chunk sha256 so they can verify each piece.
Priya (Eng): Packaging notes: we can produce a delta-aware bundle split into: runtime container layer, model weights shards, and config/metadata. Typical sizes: runtime ~350MB, model shards vary (int8 ~1.2GB total split into 8x chunks), deltas between minor releases often <40MB if model-only changes.
Jordan (Sec): From security POV need: signed SBOM (CycloneDX), SLSA attestation or reproducible build hash, signed chunk manifests, and an HSM-backed signing key (we can integrate PKCS#11 or Azure Key Vault HSM wrap). Also must provide chain-of-custody template for courier transfers.
Ben (SE): Offline activation flow we use: customer provides a node-id list, we generate activation blobs per-node, ops imports via CLI. Example verify command we give them:

# verify bundle signature
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify redwood_pub.pem -signature bundle.sig bundle.tar.gz

And chunk verification: sha256sum -c chunks.sha256

Priya (Eng): Important: if they request an 18-month major upgrade freeze we can support that, but we will require a security-patching agreement: critical CVE patches shipped as deltas. If they refuse patches entirely, that is a contractual risk we must escalate.
Cara (Finance): Pricing options: 1) per-node perpetual license + annual support, 2) per-core subscription (better for dense clusters), 3) pilot: 10 nodes free for 45 days or discounted PoC rate. For enterprise commit we can do a blended rate that approximates Dedicated reserved pricing. Need expected node count to give numbers.
Amy (Sales): Action items: @Jordan produce the chain-of-custody template + SBOM sample, @Priya provide bundle chunking plan and delta frequency doc, @Ben prepare the offline activation snippet and verification checklist, @Cara draft a simple price-option table. I'll reply to customer and suggest Wed 9am for tech sync.
Jordan (Sec): Will post checklist + sample CycloneDX SBOM by EOD. Flag: if they require FIPS-validated crypto only, we need to confirm runtime images use FIPS libs; that can add ~2 weeks to packaging.
Ben (SE): Also confirm their HSM vendor. Thales/Entrust/Yubi supported via PKCS#11. If they want an air-gapped key ceremony, we can support manual signing with our build team and provide signed hashes + attestation.
Amy (Sales): Good point. Greenline, please confirm HSM vendor and whether FIPS-only builds required. Also confirm transport method: courier HDD or an approved jumpbox VM.
deploy-bot: artifact a-20240910-77 signed (sha256: a1b2c3...) uploaded to internal-artifacts (2024-09-10T11:22:10Z)
Cara (Finance): For SOW template I'll propose: PoC 10 nodes, 45 days, pilot discount X% (TBD), optional conversion to 12-month per-node subscription. Need to know their legal review timeline.
Priya (Eng): Minor tech blocker: if they want models quantized beyond int8 (eg int4) we may need to provide a separate quantized bundle and verify perf/regression — that adds ~1 week.
Amy (Sales): Thanks team. I'll send a short preflight to Greenline with these bullets and lock Wed 9am. :thumbsup:
